name: hendy-suite-monorepo
description: Hendy Web Suite monorepo: admin, studio, public site and Cloudflare Worker API

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:apps && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck --workspace=@hendy/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hendy/core-utils
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run typecheck --workspace=@hendy/admin-web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hendy/studio-web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hendy/site
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:admin && npm run build:studio && npm run build:site && npm run build:api
